title: Rusted inside
body: Rust spots appeared inside the kettle within two weeks and the water tastes metallic.

title: 水垢
body: 用了三周壶底一层白垢，煮出来的水有股味。

title: Handle gets hot
body: The handle gets too hot to hold without a cloth when the water is boiling.

title: Leaks at the base
body: Water seeps out at the base and the counter is wet after every boil.

title: Loud boil
body: It boils fast but the rattling noise is loud enough to hear from the next room.

title: 开关坏了
body: 用了三个月开关就按不下去了，只能拔插头断电。

title: Good, odd lid
body: Boils quickly, but the lid does not click shut properly and pops open when pouring.

title: Takes ages
body: Six minutes to boil a litre, my old one did it in three.

title: Simple and fast
body: Boils fast, no plastic taste, and it is easy to fill.

title: 壶嘴漏水
body: 倒水的时候沿着壶嘴往下流，每次都洒一桌子。

title: Cheap plastic taste
body: Even after ten boils the water still tastes of plastic.

title: Too tall
body: It does not fit under the tap in my small sink, so I fill it with a jug.

title: Lid won't stay
body: The lid pops open while boiling and steam burns my hand.

title: 底座烫
body: 底座烧完水烫得不能碰，家里有小孩很危险。

title: Not worth the price
body: Double the price of the supermarket brand and it boils no faster.

title: 噪音
body: 烧水时嗡嗡响，比旧壶吵不少。

title: Died in a month
body: It stopped switching off at boiling point, then stopped heating at all.

title: Scale won't come off
body: The scale on the element is baked on and no amount of vinegar removes it.

title: Decent, drippy spout
body: Boils fine, but the spout drips a little every time I pour and leaves marks on the counter.

title: 满意
body: 烧水快，壶身不烫手，价格也合适。

title: 漏水
body: 壶身接缝处渗水，用了一个月就这样。

title: Broken switch
body: The switch broke in the on position, so it kept boiling until I unplugged it.

title: Too small
body: One litre is not enough for four cups of tea, I have to boil twice.

title: Hot to touch
body: The outside gets hot, not boiling hot but enough to make you careful.

title: 塑料味
body: 烧了十几次还是有塑料味，不敢给孩子喝。

title: Noisy element
body: There is a loud crackling from the element while it heats.

title: Overpriced
body: Looks nice but it is a kettle, and this costs as much as a coffee machine.

title: 尺寸太大
body: 太大太重，单手倒水很吃力，水槽也放不下。

title: Water tastes odd
body: The water has a chemical aftertaste even after descaling.

title: Works, slow
body: Fine for the price but it takes noticeably longer than my old kettle.

title: Base connector corroded
body: The contacts on the base corroded after a few months and it only heats if I wiggle it.

title: Great
body: Fast, quiet, and the keep warm function actually works.

title: 溢水
body: 水加多了会从壶盖溢出来，设计有问题。

title: Stinks
body: There is a burnt smell from the base after every use.

title: 水垢难清
body: 壶底水垢刷不掉，得用除垢剂泡。

title: Flimsy lid hinge
body: The lid hinge is thin plastic and is already loose.

title: 不保温
body: 说是保温，实际上十分钟就凉了，不值。

title: Dead on arrival
body: It did not heat at all out of the box, the indicator light came on but nothing happened.
